split_discipline.train: 2,499-2,500 rows per dev task; used only to fit the model or head.
split_discipline.dev: 748-750 rows per dev task; used for architecture, hyper-parameter, and protocol decisions. Inspected by the 2026-10-30 context experiment, so it is legacy development evidence, not fresh confirmation.

calibration.rule: Calibration must be a separate partition carved before fitting and disjoint from train, dev, and locked. The v1 dev suite has no calibration partition, and no threshold was fitted for the argmax context experiment. A calibration run requires a new suite version.

split_discipline.final: The locked suite is sealed and opened once, after the method is frozen. It never supplies calibration rows.

family_weight_rule: Families are equally weighted for a descriptive composite only; per-family results are primary. No dataset may exceed 0.25 of its family dev weight.

runbook: Pin jev-1.13.0 for alignment with C2-C5; jev-1.14.0 for current-product comparison.
Freeze and hash the request JSON: state, instructions, criteria, option order, image header.
Respect primitives: Choice <=255 options; decompose larger label sets hierarchically.
Permute option order on a sample; 1.13 has documented first-option bias.
Calibrate Noul/Choice/Score thresholds on dev only; freeze before locked.
Log resolved model, tokens, latency, cost, raw probabilities, request/response hashes, retries.
Do not mix published points and local runs; a paired claim needs identical rows and request bytes.
Do not redistribute raw outputs unless the applicable terms allow it.
comparator.licence_warning: Bonn responses are under the Jev Responses License 1.0: research/evaluation only; no distillation, no imitation training, no competing-product use, no redistribution. The TypeSafe site terms are not a substitute for the API/customer agreement.

required_measurements: Accuracy at 2k, 8k, 32k, and 64k bytes if claimed.
Evidence position early/middle/late; 0/4/8 distractors; distributed evidence.
Full-context vs retrieval-then-decide; retrieval recall and evidence coverage.
Latency p50/p95, peak memory, cost at each length.
Truncation audit: items that lost the answer or hypothesis.
No single long prompt counts as a capability result.

Licences unresolved for SST-5, DocVQA, ChartQA, VisualMRC, SlideVQA, InfographicsVQA, PolicyQA/OPP-115, and the LegalBench subset.
No long-context result beyond 5,120 bytes; 16k/32k are projections.
No visual encoder or image path; VisualEvidence anchors are planned.
No contamination audit for the new datasets; existing audit is verbatim-only.
Split ambiguity in FEVER, QASPER, BFCL, tau2, CUAD, PolicyQA, and LegalBench.
Comparator conflicts for AG News, DAIR Emotion, Banking77, and XNLI.
Jev 255-option limit requires decomposition for larger label sets.
Jev 1.13 vs 1.14: public evidence is 1.13; no independent 1.14 result found.
Image licence/storage cost for DocVQA, ChartQA, VisualMRC, SlideVQA.
Local Banking77 mirror is 14 rows short; do not merge the 3,076 and 3,080 counts.

definitions.published_reference: A vendor or third-party published number. It names a source, version, split, and n; it is not a row produced by this study.
definitions.local_reconstruction: A stored per-example comparator vector reconstructed locally. It is not a live model call and is not a reproduced run.
definitions.reproduced_live: Same rows, same pinned model version, same frozen request, live call, with request and response hashes. None exists here.

comparator_classes.live_reproduction_claim: Zero. No point in this registry is a live reproduced Jev run. The Banking77 0.924 cell is a local reconstruction, not a run.
